motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Story HUD reveal (500ms, 8px rise) and feed view-transition reorder (420ms).

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Background-colour hover on the header invite cell and the submit block.

motion.name: chip-toggle
motion.purpose: Chip background, text and border colour; press scales to 0.97.

motion.name: feed-reorder
motion.purpose: View-transition glide when the ranked feed reorders; skipped under reduced motion or where unsupported.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Event strip loop; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: call-and-response
motion.value: reach 220px, ripple 340px/s, answer ±0.5s, swell up to 1.4x plus brightness, ring Ember 14%
motion.purpose: Tap on the dark field: cloud motes within reach flash back nearest first; one fading 1px ring marks the call. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: cloud-drift
motion.value: curl-noise flow, 0.012 field-heights/s, currents shift 0.02/s; twinkle = max(0.62 + 0.3 sin φ, ((1 + cos φ)/2)^24), period 1.8 to 6s
motion.purpose: The cloud swirls like smoke without bunching; each mote shimmers with a brief spark. Drawn in 8 brightness steps; step 0 is not drawn.

motion.name: pointer-stir
motion.value: home + offset; spring 11/s², damping 4.6/s (ζ≈0.7); sweeps the whole path since last frame (≤12 points), radius 90px, quadratic falloff, frame-rate-independent easing to 20% of hand speed (cap 1600px/s) + up to 160px/s outward, scaled by hand speed (full at 600px/s) and fading with offset; on-path motes part to alternate sides; hero touch-action pan-y pinch-zoom, pointercancel ends the path
motion.purpose: A hand moving through the dark sweeps the lights aside and they spring home, so the cloud heals instead of scarring. A stopped pointer does not stir. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: wake-into-step
motion.value: awake = smoothstep(4·reach), decay τ 3.2s; Kuramoto pull 9/s × awake towards a 1.6s beat; lift 0.35·awake·flash(φ, 4) over resting (only motes already showing, limited by text clearance), swell up to 1.25x
motion.purpose: Lights a hand passes fall into step with the mark's tail and flash together, then drift apart: the North Star made interactive.

motion.name: gathered-mark
motion.value: count clamp(size²/32, 800, 3400); gather from 0.4s over 3.2s, per-light stagger, smootherstep flight; mark-light swell max-not-sum, cap 1.4x; crowd thinned to 20% inside; centred in the measured .hero__stage band, size ≤ 78% of band; stacked: size ≤ min(30% h, 62% w), centred; wide (≥900px): size ≤ min(46% h, 28% w), right-aligned to gutter
motion.purpose: Part of the hero cloud gathers into the Firefly mark: Dusk/Ember wings, a solid Glow tail keeping the beat. Shown gathered under reduced motion.

motion.name: text-clearance
motion.value: brightness 0.06 from 42% of height (narrow, <720px) or 50% (wide), over a 20% smoothstep; bottom 8% fades to 0
motion.purpose: Keeps text on near-clean black; the cloud also spends its motes above the text.

motion.name: field-sync
motion.value: gather 0.32 to 0.5; lit 0.4 to 0.52; Kuramoto coupling 0 to 2.4 over 0.58 to 0.86 (smoothstep)
motion.purpose: Scroll-driven story field; pod cross-fades Ember to solid Glow with a 40% Muted ring; the cloud dims 55% while the pod is lit; max step 1/20 s; pixel ratio capped at 2; pauses off-screen and on tab hide.

motion.name: reduced-motion-field
motion.purpose: No stir or call. Hero draws the cloud with the mark gathered; the story draws its end state (pod gathered, lit, in step).

narrative.overview:
Firefly's world is a dark city full of small lights, and one of them answers you. Soft black runs edge to edge; above the text hangs a dense cloud of thousands of tiny flat squares in three tones (Glow, Dusk violet and Ember warm white), gathered in clumps and dark voids and drifting like smoke. Over it sits a civic, almost municipal grotesk layer: very large, tight Host Grotesk in warm white, small two-line labels, hairline rules and solid square cells. Nothing is decorated. Hierarchy comes from size and from the muted-over-ink pairing, not from weight, colour or containers.

The interface has no blue (decided 2026-11-25). Black is the ground and the neutrals are warm. Dusk is violet, not blue: it comes from the cloud and returns in the interface as a quiet second accent for state and for "Coming next". Night and Wing survive only inside the logo files, and the mark keeps its own colours wherever it appears. The landing page (`src/features/landing/`) is always dark regardless of the visitor's setting, a confirmed exception. App screens will follow the system light/dark setting, but no light system has been built, so this file records no light-mode tokens; the root stylesheet's light defaults are placeholders.

Motion is drawn from real fireflies. The cloud drifts along a curl-noise flow and twinkles. Stir: a pointer or finger moving through the dark parts the cloud and makes it eddy. Call and response: tap the dark and the lights nearby flash back in a ripple. Falling into step: on scroll, five strangers gather, turn solid Glow and synchronise (Kuramoto coupling) while the cloud dims around them. Every motion has a still frame. There is no photography; example events and the example pod are synthetic and say so, and features that have not launched carry a "Coming next" label.
keyCharacteristics: Soft black ground edge to edge; warm neutrals; no blue in the interface.
One Glow highlight per screen in the interface, always solid. The cloud is atmosphere.
Dusk violet as the quiet second accent: picked state, "Coming next", separators.
Host Grotesk only, regular weight, tight negative tracking; size carries hierarchy.
Two-line labels: a context line over the warm-white fact.
Hairline rules and square cells instead of cards, shadows or gradients.
Flat squares, dots and hairline grass; the only soft light is a firefly's halo as it glows.
Phone first from 360px; everything readable with the motion switched off.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Each screen of interface has exactly one Glow highlight: in the feed demo the best-fit dot, in the story the pod, in the invite section the submit block. The hero has no Glow interface element; its light is the cloud. Glow motes in the cloud are atmosphere and do not count, but no interface element other than the one highlight may be Glow.

rules.name: The Quiet Dusk Rule
rules.body: Dusk marks state and what is coming; it never competes with Glow. It is never the call to action, never the best-fit signal, never the pod. If a reader's eye goes to Dusk before Glow, Dusk is doing too much.

rules.name: The No Blue Rule
rules.body: The interface has no blue. Grounds are black, neutrals are warm, Dusk is violet. Night and Wing exist only inside the mark, which keeps its own colours.

rules.name: The Solid Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow as a highlight is drawn at full opacity; dimmed Glow turns olive. Lit pod dots flash by swelling, not fading. (Cloud motes step through brightness; they are not a highlight.)

rules.name: The No Glow on Paper Rule
rules.body: Glow never carries text or an essential indicator on a light surface; on light, the glow becomes Night (brand/README.md).

rules.name: The Size Not Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is carried by size and by the muted/ink pairing. Display and headline stay at 400; nothing on the page is bold.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.01em at item and input, -0.02em at title, -0.03em at statement, -0.035em at headline, -0.04em at display.

rules.name: The Flat Light Rule
rules.body: Every light is flat, with one exception. Dust motes and the mark are solid squares; the pod, the best-fit dot and the marquee separators are solid circles; a flash on any of them is shown by size and brightness. The exception (approved 2026-11-26, "soft halo, flashes only"): a firefly in the field glows with a soft radial halo while it flashes, drawn under its flat core. Nothing else in the system gets blur, bloom or glow.

dos: Do keep one Glow highlight per screen in the interface, at full opacity.
Do use Dusk only as a quiet second accent: picked state, "Coming next", separators.
Do keep the interface blue-free: black grounds and warm neutrals; Night and Wing only inside the mark.
Do set display type in Host Grotesk 400 with negative tracking (-0.04em at display).
Do pair a context line over an Ink fact for labels.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines at Ink 13%, and frame controls with Ink 28%.
Do keep header cells, chips, buttons and inputs square (0 radius).
Do thin the field behind text instead of putting text on a panel.
Do give every motion a still version under reduced motion, and pause canvas loops when off-screen or the tab is hidden.
Do label example events and the example pod as made up, and unlaunched features as "Coming next".
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, blur, bloom or glows to dust, dots, the mark or surfaces (a flashing firefly's halo is the one exception).
Don't make Dusk a call to action or a highlight that competes with Glow.
Don't use bold weights for hierarchy; use size.
Don't wrap content in cards; the drawn phone is the one framed object.
Don't use Night, Wing or any blue as an interface fill, text or rule colour.
Don't put Glow text or essential Glow indicators on a light surface.
Don't load fonts from a CDN; Host Grotesk is self-hosted.
Don't invent light-mode tokens from the landing page; the light system is unbuilt.
